articleTitle: Measurement and Modeling of Wide-Range Magnetic Core Losses under PWM Excitation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Error in the direct current power method for measuring magnetic core losses mainly depends on the accurate measurement of device losses in the DC/AC inverter circuit. The existing calibration models for measurement devices fail to reflect the effects of switch states and duty cycles, thus reducing the accuracy of the model. In this study, the operational states of the inverter circuit with different duty cycles and switch states were analyzed, and theoretical analysis was conducted on the losses of each part. Consequently, a symmetric/asymmetric PWM excitation-based calibration model for DC/AC inverter losses, considering the effects of switch transitions and duty cycles, was proposed. Experimental validation showed that the predicted losses using this model were more accurate compared to existing two-parameter and eight-parameter models.

articleTitle: The Numerical Modeling and Analysis of Conducted EMI for Four-Switch Buck-Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: With the rapid development of switching frequency and power density of four-switch Buck-Boost (FSBB) converter, the conducted electromagnetic interference (EMI) of FSBB converter is becoming increasingly severe. This paper introduced the working principle of FSBB converter, analyzed the common-mode (CM) and differential-mode (DM) noise sources and conducted paths of FSBB, established a numerical model to calculate its EMI spectrum and proposed some EMI suppression and filter design strategies based on the modeling results. Through simulation, This paper verified the reliability of this numerical calculation, then compared and analyzed the difference of EMI spectrum between quadrangle control and three-mode control.

articleTitle: Structural design of carbon-based filler in polymer matrix composites for electromagnetic interference shielding: A mini review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Over the past few years, with the continuous innovation of technology in the electronics industry, the demand for electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding has grown strongly. To meet these significantly increased needs, a lot of materials have been investigated to replace the traditional shielding materials for EMI shielding. The nonmetallic materials of polymer matrix composites possess the advantages of low density, corrosion resistance, competitive prices, and easy processing have attracted great attention. In polymer matrix composites, the carbon-based filler exhibits lightweight, cost-effective, and excellent thermal/electrical properties, which could effectively absorb and reflect EM waves. This review systematically summarizes the recent research on the carbon-based filler in the polymer matrix composites, covering the graphene, transition metal carbon/nitride, metal-organic frameworks derived carbon, and other materials (wood-derived carbon composite and graphitic carbon nitride). The review briefly discusses the research progress in the structural design of fillers in polymer matrix composites.

articleTitle: Calculation model of leakage inductance of planar transformer based on image method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: As a common magnetic component of small and medium power switching power supplies, planar transformers' leakage inductance is an important factor affecting the stability and efficiency of switching power supplies. The traditional one-dimensional Dowell model does not take into account the uneven current distribution of PCB windings due to the eddy current effect at high frequencies, resulting in a large error in leakage inductance calculation. To address the shortcomings of the one-dimensional Dowell model, this paper divides the PCB winding into several parallel conductors and calculates the current value of the parallel conductors. Then, the magnetic field intensity of the transformer window is obtained by using the mirror method, and next the leakage inductance of the planar transformer is calculated.

articleTitle: Active X-Y Capacitors Based Hybrid EMI Filter Design
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The bulky common-mode (CM) chokes and large differential-mode (DM) capacitors in passive EMI filters (PEFs) make them unsuitable for high power density converters. The active EMI filters (AEFs) with smaller size have limited high-frequency filtering effect and are difficult to meet the needs of various converters. The hybrid EMI filters (HEFs) composed of active and passive filters have the advantages of wider filtering range and have gradually become a widely used filter. However, the existing HEFs only deal with suppressing CM or DM noise. In this paper, a HEF based on active X-Y capacitors is proposed to suppress both CM and DM noise with a smaller size. Firstly, the characteristics that active X-Y capacitors can amplify the effective value of capacitors in the conducted interference frequency range are analyzed, and then the passive X-Y capacitors in PEF are replaced by active X-Y capacitors respectively to construct HEF, so that the value of CM inductor and DM capacitor required by the filter can be reduced under the same EMI suppression effect. The simulation results show that the proposed HEF can attenuate both CM and DM noise by more than 20dB in the conducted EMI frequency range. Compared with traditional PEF, the CM inductance of HEF can be reduced by 60%, and the DM capacitance can be reduced by 90% with similar filtering effect.

articleTitle: Plane Wave Excited Coaxial Cables Coupling Model and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: the modeling method of electromagnetic coupling problem of overhead shielded cable on lossy ground plane is studied. Based on the Agrawal model of coaxial cable, the induced skin current of the shield layer under external field irradiation is obtained, and the internal excitation source of the core is obtained by the transfer impedance and transfer admittance parameters of the coaxial cable. The numerical results show that the core induced current increases with the increase of cable length, as well as the peak induced current and the time of rising and falling edge of current. The induced current of the core wire decreases with the increase of the distance from the ground plane. With the increase of terminal impedance, the reflection modulus increases, the reflection of the induced signal at both ends increases, and the amplitude of the induced signal decreases. When the incident polarization Angle is [0,90°], the induced current of the core wire decreases with the increase of the polarization Angle. With the increase of the earth conductivity, the amplitude of the induced current at the end of the core wire decreases.

articleTitle: Protection Design and Device Selection of Power Line Under Nanosecond Fast Risingtime Pulse
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Nanosecond fast pulse can damage the power supply module through field-line coupling. Therefore, a power supply protection circuit module under nanosecond fast pulse is designed. At the same time, a selection principle of EMP protection devices is put forward from the aspects of maximum impulse spark-over voltage, response time, clamping voltage and flux. According to this principle, a new power supply protection circuit module is selected for nanosecond fast pulse design and simulation verification. The simulation results show that the three-piece metal oxide varistor parallel power supply protection module designed according to this selection design principle can effectively protect DC power supply.

articleTitle: Improved Radiated EMI Analysis Model Based on Modeling of Spatial Electromagnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: With the rapid development of switching frequency and power density of high-density power supply (HDPS, the radiated electromagnetic interference (EMI) of converters is becoming increasingly severe. Different from traditional radiated EMI scalar model, the paper established an improved radiated EMI analysis model for power converters based on modeling for the spatial electromagnetic field of equivalent antenna. Through the improved model, the paper studied the spatial distribution of radiation gain and the vertical and horizontal polarization of radiated EMI for a PFC-LLC power module. The variation pattern of the vertical and horizontal polarization components of radiated EMI obtained by the improved model is consistent with actual situation The improved radiated EMI analysis model accurately estimates radiated EMI in most research frequency band.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Failure Threshold of Digital Circuit Under Different Electromagnetic Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Digital circuits failure problem usually occurs in electronic equipment due to electromagnetic disturbance. Therefore, it is necessary to study the failure mechanism of digital circuits under different electromagnetic disturbance. The circuit failure behavior under mixed interference of electrical fast transient (EFT) and surge is tested and analyzed. This paper innovatively proposes an evaluation method of failure threshold of digital circuit, which is suitable for evaluating both single and mixed interference. The proposed evaluation method is dependent on the product of amplitude and slope of chip port voltage, avoiding the difficulty and poor accuracy of current measurement. Through tests under different interference, the evaluation method is verified. With the evaluation method, the failure mechanism of the circuit under different disturbance is clearly quantified, which is significant for the anti-interference quantitative design of digital circuits.

articleTitle: A Least Squares Fitting-Based Method for Assessing the HPM radiation effects
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In response to the updated environmental adaptability requirements for high-power microwave (HPM) outlined in the GJB1389B-2022 standard, and addressing the challenges associated with comprehensive evaluations of large-scale electronic information systems, this manuscript presents a focused study on a planar spiral antenna. To facilitate this research, a controlled small-scale HPM radiation environment was carefully constructed, allowing for the precise capture of coupled voltage data under regulated radiation exposures. Through the utilization of least squares fitting, key parameters were ascertained for a linear model representing the radiation effects. Rigorous verification at an HPM radiation field strength of 9.41 kV/m corroborated the model’s veracity, revealing a minor discrepancy of only 1.33 dB between the fitted value and the empirical measurement, thus confirming the model’s high degree of accuracy. The methodological approach detailed in this paper, predicated upon the construction of a small-scale HPM environment and the derivation of a linear model based on empirical data, offers a robust and reliable means for the assessment and evaluation of equipment's susceptibility to HPM radiation effects.

articleTitle: Modeling for Conducted Electromagnetic Interference of High Voltage Motor Drive System of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: At present, 800V high voltage drive system has become the development direction of new energy vehicles. Electromagnetic interference (EMI) is a major challenge in system design. In order to predict EMI and verify the effectiveness of EMI suppression technology at the initial stage of system design, a SPICE equivalent circuit modeling method for motor drive system based on port impedance measurement is proposed. According to the physical structure of the system components, the IGBT module model High voltage (HV)DC and AC busbar model, busbar support capacitor model, HVDC shielded cable model, and drive motor model are established, and parasitic parameters are accurately extracted. A complete EMI prediction model of motor drive system is constructed by combining the component models together. According to GB/T 18655-2018 and GB/T 36282-2018, simulation and experiment of system conducted EMI are carried out to verify the accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Design of Hybrid EMI Filter with Output Voltage Enhancement Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: With advancement in semiconductor technology, the switching speed of the latest generation of power semiconductor devices has increased to approximately ten times that of traditional devices. However, the continuous switching operation of the inverter in motor drive system generates electromagnetic interference (EMI) noise. To restrain EMI at the output side of inverters in motor drive system and suppress high-amplitude common-mode (CM) voltage, a hybrid EMI filter (HEF) with an output voltage enhancement structure is designed. An output voltage expansion circuit of the operational amplifier and a current push-pull amplification circuit are built, improving the output capability of the amplifier and providing greater compensation capability compared to traditional active EMI filters. The component parameters are set according to circuit requirements. A high-frequency model of the hybrid EMI filter is established to analyze the influence of component parameters on system performance and stability at high frequency. The effectiveness of the hybrid EMI filter is verified through experiment.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of EMI Filter Based on Electric Vehicle Charging Station Power Module
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Compared with traditional fuel vehicles, the electromagnetic environment inside electric vehicles is intricate, and there are more severe EMI problems. In this article, a EMI filter design for the input terminal and output terminal of charging station power converter is proposed. Based on the working principles of the first stage three-phase Vienna Power Factor Correction AC-DC converter and the second stage LLC series/parallel resonant converter, a simulation model of the charging station power module is constructed, and the filtering effect of the EMI filter is verified through MATLAB simulation. Through experiments, this article confirms the reliability and performance of the EMI filter.

articleTitle: Design of T-type CM EMI Filter Based on Planar Electromagnetic Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The application of high-frequency switching components has made the switching frequency of the inverter develop towards higher frequency, which also brings serious electromagnetic interference (EMI) problems. The LCL filter has good low frequency filtering effect. The symmetrical LCL filter can improve the EMI suppression effect while ensuring the harmonic suppression effect. However, the common mode (CM) noise cannot be suppressed below the standard line, so further design of the CM EMI filter is required. The insertion loss of a single-stage CM EMI filter is 40dB/dec, and the insertion loss of a double-stage CM EMI filter can be increased to 80dB/dec. However, the double-stage CM EMI filter uses more CM capacitors, which will lead to an increase in leakage current. Based on this, a T-type CM EMI filter is proposed, which uses two CM inductors and two CM capacitors. The insertion loss can be increased to 60 dB/dec without increasing the number of capacitors used, and planar electromagnetic integration design is carried out for T-type CM EMI filter to reduce size and weight. By building an inverter experimental platform based on GaN, the filtering effect of the designed filter is verified.

articleTitle: Human electromagnetic safety assessment of AC cables for motor drive system of electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In order to study the electromagnetic safety of the human body in the electromagnetic field generated by the AC cable for motor drives of an electric vehicle at 400KHz, the circuit simulation software is used to construct a model of motor drives for an electric vehicle considering parasitic parameters and obtain the common mode current on the AC cable. CST Cable Studio is used to construct the model of electromagnetic radiation from the AC cable model of the electric vehicle and the human body model, to obtain the electromagnetic environment of the human body at different seat at 400 KHz, and to evaluate the electromagnetic safety of human beings in this electromagnetic environment according to international standards. The results of all the simulations show that driver is exposed to the strongest electromagnetic radiation among all the seat, but the Specific Absorption Rate(SAR) of the environment for all the passengers is less than the recommended value of electromagnetic exposure for the public set by the International Commission on Non-Ionizing Radiation Protection(ICNIRP), and the electromagnetic field generated by the AC cable does not pose a threat to the health of the passengers in the car. Finally, it was found that the way the cables are arranged and the material of the front partition of the compartment have a greater influence on the electromagnetic radiation inside the vehicle, which is also a factor to be considered.

articleTitle: Analysis of the impact of long-term service of inverter devices on electromagnetic compatibility
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Taking the IGBT power module of the inverter device as the research object, finite element analysis technology was used to explore the influence of long-term service on the thermal characteristics and stress-strain of the IGBT module. At the same time, the influence of service aging on the electromagnetic compatibility performance of the device was studied, and the finite element simulation results were verified through accelerated aging experiments. The results showed that during the long-term operation of the IGBT module, due to the different thermal expansion coefficients of its materials, strain differences were found, ultimately leading to an increase in its ground capacitance, resulting in an increase in the amplitude of the common mode conducted noise of the device by 3dBμA in the frequency band after 20MHz. This study will provide theoretical guidance for the electromagnetic compatibility design of inverter devices for long-term service.

articleTitle: Frequency Calculation and Selection for Nonlinear Parity-Time Symmetric Wireless Power System Considering Electromagnetic Compatibility
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The nonlinear parity-time symmetric wireless power transfer (PT-WPT) system has attracted significant attention due to its robustness against variations in transmission distance. In practical applications, factors such as parameter variation may cause the natural resonant frequencies of the transmitting and receiving circuits to be deviate. This paper utilizes the Shengjin formula to derive an analytical solution for the operating frequency and investigate the power transfer characteristics under detuning conditions. To select the operating frequency, a method involving adjustment of the compensation capacitance on the receiving side is employed. Additionally, a full-bridge inverter controlled by DSP is implemented to achieve nonlinear negative resistance. Finally, a prototype is constructed and the electromagnetic compatibility is simulated. They validate the model's accuracy and evaluate the effectiveness and rationality of the frequency selection method.

articleTitle: An Efficient Local Time-Stepping Scheme for Discontinuous Galerkin Multi-scale Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: This paper presents a local time-stepping technique that uses different time steps based on the mesh density. By evaluating the diameters of the inscribed spheres of the meshes, the maximum allowable time step for each mesh is determined. This method effectively improves simulation efficiency, especially for models with multiscale structures, significantly reducing the consumption of computational resources and simulation time. The same numerical example was tested for both global and local time-stepping to compare computation durations, and the results show that, compared to global time-stepping scheme, local time-stepping scheme improved computation efficiency by 150 times.

articleTitle: Modeling of High Voltage to Low Voltage Crosstalk Coupling Paths in Electric Vehicle Motor Drive Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: A method for modelling the equivalent circuit of the LV and HV coupling path of a motor drive system based on port impedance measurement is proposed. First, the crosstalk coupling mechanism of the HV system to the LV system is analysed. Then, the crosstalk coupling path model is established by measuring the S21 parameters of the HV and LV coupling paths of the cable, the controller, and the motor drive system respectively. The deviation between simulations and experimental measurements is less than 8 dB, which indicates that the established crosstalk path model has a good accuracy. By using the coupling path model to conduct HV and LV crosstalk coupling analysis, it can be seen that reducing the length, spacing, ground clearance, and load impedance of HV and LV cables can effectively reduce HV and LV coupling. Reducing the parasitic capacitance of the HV power circuit of the motor controller to the ground and the inductance of the HV and LV circuits can effectively reduce the internal crosstalk coupling of the controller.

articleTitle: Complex Permeability Determination for EE Core Based on Flexible PCB Fixture and Magnetic Flux Path Length Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The complex permeability of magnetic cores acts as a vital factor in electromagnetic interference (EMI) filtering choke design and optimization. Many efforts have been reported for toroid cores, but fewer target those with other shapes, such as EE, EI, UU, and UI cores. Owing to their commonly used in planar EMI filters, determining the complex permeability of them is of significance. Targeting EE cores, this paper presents a flexible printed circuit board (PCB)-based fixture adapter tailored designed for performing the measurement, while the corresponding core permeability can be calculated through magnetic flux path length analysis. The experiments validate the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed methods, spanning a wide frequency range up to 120 MHz.

articleTitle: Simulation and Suppression of the Voltage between Negative Line and Ground in DC Traction Power Supply System with Special Return Rail
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In order to avoid the electric corrosion from DC traction power supply return rail to adjacent lines and pipes, special return rail with good insulation to ground is began to adopted in the newly-built power supply system. When the power converter in the power supply system works, an interference voltage between the special return rail and ground is generated, which interferes the frame protection of power supply equipment, and affects the normal operation of whole system. The generation mechanism of interference voltage between negative line and ground in the DC traction power supply system with special rail return is explained in this paper. A diode model considering its response speed is proposed, and a simulation model of negative line to ground voltage is established. Based on the simulation model, the influence of negative line to ground impedance on negative-ground voltage is simulated. A method to suppress the negative ground voltage of the DC traction power supply system is proposed and verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A high energy density hybrid EMI filter based on improved MCMC
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved Multi-Function Common Mode Choke (MCMC), and designs a high energy density hybrid EMI filter (HEF). MCMC improves the suppression effect and energy density of the filter by using the Current Transformer (CT) of the active EMI filter (AEF) as the common mode inductor in the passive EMI filter (PEF). By adding inductance to the secondary side of the CT, the improved MCMC strengthens the effective working bandwidth. And the HEF with the improved MCMC, compared to the one with the original MCMC, has significantly better noise suppression effects at both low-frequency and peak noise points, and it also has slight improvements at high frequencies. It is especially suitable for tasks that require higher filter bandwidth.

articleTitle: Improved High-pass Filter for Measuring High Frequency Common-mode Voltage with Passive Probe
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In the measurement of EMC in power electronic circuits, the amplitude of high-frequency noise is often much smaller than that of low-frequency noise. Therefore, in order to better test high-frequency interference, it is necessary to connect a high-pass filter at the output port of the signal. However, there is a high-frequency effect between the output of the high-pass filter and the probe. This results in a large difference between the output spectrum of the filter and that measured in practice when the common-mode voltage is measured. The purpose of this study is to explore the specific relationship between the oscilloscope probe and the filter output test results, as well as possible solutions. The root cause of the high frequency effect between the probe and the filter is discussed. The attenuation coefficient is taken as the main index and the influence of the passive probe end capacitance on the test results of the common mode voltage oscilloscope is analyzed qualitatively. On this basis, a method is proposed to compensate the parasitic capacitance of the end of passive detector by adjusting the filter parameters.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Integrated Design of EMI Filters based on Flexible Multilayer Foils
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The electromagnetic interference (EMI) filters with high power density and miniaturization is widely used in the design of grid-connected inverters to solve the EMI problem. While in the era of high-integrated and high-frequency power electronic technology, the improved design of EMI filters has become an important topic, which aims to achieve the lightweight and miniaturization of filters. Therefore, in order to process conducted EMI, the electromagnetic integrated design of EMI filters based on flexible multilayer foils (FMLFs) is proposed in this study. Compared with traditional integrated EMI filters, electromagnetic integrated EMI filters based on FMLFs perform better. Besides, their noise suppression effect is comparable to that of discrete filters. In addition, they also have advantages in terms of volume, weight and efficiency. Finally, experiments have been conducted on a single-phase SiC inverter to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Analytical modeling and analysis of conducted electromagnetic interference of AC-DC converter based on new admittance matrix
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Power electronic equipment brings convenience to our life, but also brings harmonic pollution. With the continuous improvement of the switching frequency, the EMI problem of the circuit gradually comes into the public view, and the EMI analysis of the circuit becomes more and more important. In this paper, the electromagnetic noise source and coupling path of the conducted EMI of the bidirectional switch bridgeless PFC are analyzed. According to the equivalent circuit of the conducted EMI, an analytical model based on the admittance matrix is established. The theoretical common mode noise spectrum and differential mode noise spectrum of the bidirectional switch bridgeless PFC in CCM mode, DCM mode and CRM mode are calculated and obtained, and compared with the simulated spectrum. The calculation results are close to the simulation results, and the model fitting effect is good. Finally, the conducted EMI of two-phase interleaved parallel topology is modeled and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research On Strong Electromagnetic Environment Coupling Effect of Front-end Devices in RF System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In this paper, the low noise amplifier is used as an important sensitive device of the RF system, and the strong electromagnetic environment coupling effect is researched. In the beginning, the core technical metrics parameters of low noise amplifier under strong electromagnetic environment are introduced. And then a semi-physical test platform is built, and the experimental research on the low noise amplifier is realized by the injection method. Finally, a certain type of low noise amplifier is selected for test and verification, and the influence of different pulse widths and repetition periods is analyzed. Experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper could effectively support the protection of electronic devices, and support the electromagnetic protection and reinforcement design of the whole system. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Radiated Susceptibility Testing and IEMI Reinforcement of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Against Motor-Related Failures
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Critical aviation electrical apparatus such as an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) is vulnerable to intentional electromagnetic interference (IEMI), which can lead to severe system failures. Among them, motor-related failures are particularly detrimental, resulting in mission termination and significant property loss. Through susceptibility testing, the immunity of an UAV can be systematically assessed, enabling further enhancements to ensure the normal operation under complex electromagnetic environments. Using a commercial DJI UAV as a case study, this article details the methodology and considerations for its radiated susceptibility testing at a wide frequency range from 2 MHz to 18 GHz. Relying on the vulnerability information, a comprehensive hardening solution is illustrated, which shows good effectiveness and facilitates the UAV against IEMI attack with the electric-field (E-field) strength up to 200 V/m.

articleTitle: Improved Calibration Technique for Two-probe Setup to Reduce Measurement Errors
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: It is important to obtain in-circuit impedance for accurately evaluating the operation of electrical and designing high insertion loss filter to suppress electromagnetic interference (EMI). Two-probe setup (TPS) based on inductive coupling method is an universal method for in-circuit impedance extract because it has no electrical contact with the system under test. However, the existing measurement methods cannot reduce the measurement errors caused by the inductive coupling between the probe and the system under test. To cope with it, an in-circuit impedance measurement model which considers inductive coupling between probe and inductance in the system under test. Based on the measurement model, this paper proposes an improved calibration technique for TPS to reduce the measurement errors. The experimental results show that the proposed calibration method can reduce the measurement errors.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Pulse Source for Cable Injection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: According to the demand for electromagnetic pulse testing of cables such as equipment power lines, control lines, and data lines, design of electromagnetic pulse injection sources based on Marx generators was studied. Through circuit simulation, a Marx generator charging and discharging circuit and a pulse front sharpening circuit were designed. By designing the structure of the capacitor box, the miniaturization of the pulse source has been developed. By designing trigger switches, conduction switches, and sharpening switches, the steepening of the pulse front was achieved. Based on the optimization design results, an electromagnetic pulse injection source has been developed. The rise time of output pulse is less than 20ns, the pulse width is 500-550ns, and the current can reach 5kA when the circuit load is 60 Ω, which can meet the requirements of cable end testing and assessment.

articleTitle: The Design and Selection of DC-link Decoupling Capacitors in High-power Full SiC Voltage Source Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The oscillations that occur during high-frequency switching, caused by the stray inductance of the device package, bus-bar connection coupling, and the device junction capacitor, can interfere with the normal operation of other components in the converter. To mitigate these oscillations, a decoupling capacitor is used, which suppresses the switching-induced interference. The switching model and snubber model are analyzed to characterize the turning-off oscillation, and a multi-stage snubber circuit is proposed to enhance the overall current handling capability of the decoupling capacitor. The voltage, current, and EMI test results obtained from a full SiC auxiliary converter validate the effectiveness of the analytical method and the proposed strategies.

articleTitle: Orthogonal Dual-channel based Wireless Charging System with Free Rotation and Simultaneous Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: An orthogonal dual-channel-based wireless charging system is designed to desensitize the wireless charging system to free rotation and transmit energy and data simultaneously. The radial magnetic flux and rectangular coil make the power transmission channel insensitive to rotation and have a certain degree of anti-misalignment ability and the spiral tube-shaped magnetic coupling structure also has anti offset ability when decoupled from the power channel. In addition, the channel is rotationally symmetric. A simple decoding circuit is designed to achieve data extraction. Simulation results based on finite element and PLECS software verified the decoupling and anti-misalignment performance, verifying the proposed WCS’s feasibility.

articleTitle: Logistic-Chebyshev Cascaded Chaotic Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation for Common-Mode EMI Suppression in Motor Drive System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) is widely used in motor drive systems, and chaotic SVPWM can effectively suppress common-mode voltage spikes at the switching frequency and its multiples on the EMI spectrum by varying the switching frequency randomly within a certain range. However, the current discrete chaotic mappings commonly used to realize chaotic SVPWM suffer from uneven probability density distribution and poor randomness under limited computational precision, reducing the EMI suppression effect. This paper analyzes the generation mechanism of common-mode EMI in motor drive systems and identifies shortcomings in traditional chaotic SVPWM. Then proposes a Logistic-Chebyshev cascaded chaotic SVPWM to enhance randomness and improve the probability density distribution of mappings, aiming to improve the effectiveness of chaotic SVPWM in suppressing common-mode EMI spikes in motor drive systems. The proposed method's effectiveness is validated through MATLAB/Simulink simulations. This method provides a new approach for suppressing common-mode EMI suppression in motor drive systems.

articleTitle: Analysis and modeling of equivalent circuit of GDT under fast rising time EMP
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Fast rising time electromagnetic pulse (FREMP) has the characteristics of high power, wide band, which can generate great electromagnetic radiation energy in a short time and pose a great threat to electronic equipment. Therefore, the protection design of FREMP should be emphasized in system design. The gas discharge tube (GDT) in parallel with the protected circuit can play a key role in protecting the post-stage equipment. At present, the industry mainly studies the response characteristics of GDT under lightning 8/20us or electrostatic waveform, and there are few researches on electromagnetic pulses with nanosecond fast rising edge such as 20/500ns waveform. At the same time, the nonlinear characteristics of gas discharge tube make it difficult to model the transient response process. Therefore, based on the dynamic voltammetry characteristic curve of GDT and the key protection parameters, this paper determined the change law of the key protection parameters under FREMP pulse, and determined the Pspice circuit model of the switching device according to the method of building equivalent circuits in sections, which provided the modeling basis for the subsequent protection design. Simulation and experimental results show that the circuit is effective.

articleTitle: Harmonic Current Correction for Common Mode Voltage Reduction and Narrow Pulse Elimination Method in DC-AC Matrix Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The expected functionality of a single-stage isolated AC-DC matrix converter involves meeting the multifunctional deployment requirements of different AC/DC systems. Its design facilitates bidirectional power conversion while ensuring electrical isolation. Conversely, recent methods have greatly magnified the complexity of modulation and control programs, neglecting in-depth analysis of mathematical models. This paper presents a novel strategy of symmetric-SVM (S-SVM) to operate in discontinuous conduction mode (DCM), which improves performance in DC bias, narrow pulse, and common mode voltage. In addition, an in-depth study was conducted on the precise correlation between vector modulation ratio and three-phase sinusoidal current. The proposed method effectively reduces total harmonic distortion (THD) in three-phase currents and achieves efficient bidirectional power transmission.

articleTitle: Research on mechanism and suppression strategy of radar intermittent sampling and forwarding jamming
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Interrupted Sampling Repeater Jamming (ISRJ), as a type of coherent jamming, can obtain pulse compression gain in radar matching filtering and form a series of false target groups, which seriously restricts the detection performance of radar. In order to suppress ISRJ, this paper presents an interference suppression method based on spatial cancellation. Firstly, A mathematical model of ISRJ is established to study the jamming mechanism of ISRJ on radar system. Then, the spatial cancellation suppression model is established to eliminate interference signal by using the different arrival angles between interference and echo signals. Finally, based on the principle of power inversion adaptive algorithm, the optimal weight of power inversion is computed by LMS algorithm iteratively, and the feasibility of the algorithm is verified by simulation. The simulation results show that under the parameters in this paper, the signal-interference-noise ratio (SINR) of received signal is increased by 28.99dB. This greatly reduces the jamming effect of interference signal and enables radar to perform its detection performance normally.

articleTitle: Modeling and Design of Active Filter for EMI Cancellation in High Voltage Power Supply of Motor Controller for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The rapid switching of IGBT and other power semiconductor devices in the drive motor controller of electric vehicles generates transient voltage and transient current, resulting in conducted and radiated emissions of high-voltage lines exceeding the limits specified in the CISPR 25-2021 standard. In order to solve the problems of poor electro -magnetic interference suppression and large volume in the low-frequency range of passive EMI filters (PEF), as well as poor high-frequency interference suppression in active filters, an active EMI filter (AEF) suitable for high-voltage power supply of electric vehicle motor controllers was designed. A high-frequency circuit model of the proposed high-precision AEF was established, and a prototype of the AEF was designed. The insertion loss of AEF is greater than 35.2dB from 100kHz to 100MHz, with a maximum of 39.3dB. Compared with PEF with the same insertion loss, the proposed HEF reduces its volume by approximately 50%. When the motor operates under load, the conduction voltage of the motor controller meets the requirements of level 3 of CISPR25-2021.

articleTitle: Variable dead zone pulse width modulation to reduce conducted electromagnetic interference
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The switching of the switch will produce a lot of electromagnetic interference (EMI). The time scale of the dead zone is very small, and the actual conduction situation is determined by the direction of the current, and therefore affects the EMI at the MHz level. Based on the principle of spread spectrum modulation, a pulse width modulation (PWM) technique with variable dead zone (VDZ) is proposed in this paper. The simulation and experimental results show that the differential mode EMI can be reduced by about 5dB at 600kHz-5MHz by using VDZPWM at a constant switching frequency.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation Method of Complex Cables in Aircraft Under High-Intensity Radiation Fields
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Cable modeling of simple types and routing paths is achievable under the high-intensity radiation fields (HIRF) environment. However, the actual cable bundles in aircraft are rather complex. This manuscript reports a modeling and simulation method of complex cables in aircraft by finite difference time domain (FDTD). A series of techniques are proposed to establish more realistic cable models, including signal grounding design when the cable bundles go through the cabin, signal transmitting design when the cable path is bifurcated, equivalent modeling of complex cable type and so on. The induced current of complex cable in aircraft was obtained in the frequency range of 0.1MHz~400MHz. The simulation data is in good agreement with measurement values. Accurate numerical simulations of aircraft can be acquired before the HIRF certification processes to save time and money in the aeronautical industry.

articleTitle: Parameter identification of MC-WPT System based on Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In practical application, it is inevitable that the variation of the load, the mutual inductance, and the natural resonant frequency of coils in magnetically-coupled wireless power transmission (MC-WPT). By identifying the changing parameters, the identified parameter information can be obtained in time, and then more effective approaches can be adopted to control the system to ensure its stable and efficient operation. This paper proposes a parameter identification method based on the differential evolution algorithm (DEA), which can identify parameters of the load, the mutual inductance, and the natural resonant frequency of coils only by sampling the root-mean-square (RMS) value of fundamental current on the transmitting side. Firstly, the mathematical model of the series-series (SS) compensation topology is derived. Then, the principle of DEA and the general steps of parameter identification using DEA are introduced. Finally, simulation experimental results show that the proposed method can realize the parameter identification under system constraints, and the identification results are very close to the actual values. In addition, the proposed algorithm has better speed and accuracy than other algorithms by simulation.

articleTitle: Prediction of CM Conducted EMI Noise of High Frequency Class E Resonant Flyback Converters Based on Air-core Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: With the rapid development of power electronics technology and the significant increase in the switching frequency of power semiconductor devices, high frequency operation has become an important approach to achieving compact and lightweight systems. However, high switching frequencies also exacerbate the problem of electromagnetic interference (EMI). This paper focuses on the EMI characteristics of high frequency converters and conducts an in-depth study on the CM conducted EMI noise model of high frequency flyback converters based on air-core transformers. By precisely designing the flyback converter to operate in resonant mode and achieve soft switching of the switches, it adapts to high frequency application environments. Furthermore, a detailed analysis of the system's CM noise path is conducted, and the corresponding system model is constructed. Considering the characteristics of air-core transformers, a simplified measurement method based on a four-capacitor model is proposed in this paper to overcome the challenge of complex parameter measurement with traditional methods. Experimental results demonstrate that this model can effectively predict the EMI characteristics of high frequency converters, providing important references for the design of high frequency power electronic systems.

articleTitle: Equivalent injection test method of continuous wave high-intensity field electromagnetic radiation damage effect of RF front-end receiving component under port linear response condition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In this paper, an equivalent injection test method for the damage effect of high-level field electromagnetic radiation of the RF front-end receiving component of the frequency-using equipment is proposed, which is suitable for the situation that the reflection coefficient of the antenna and the RF front-end port is negligible and non-negligible under the condition of port linear response. For the case that the EUT output response is not convenient to monitor, a method is proposed to achieve the equality of the total forward voltage wave of the EUT input port during radiation and injection through test and calculation, and then achieve equivalence. The simulation results show the feasibility and accuracy of the experimental method.

articleTitle: Construction method of conducted EMI prediction model for high power electric drive systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Armored vehicles have gradually been equipped with electric drive systems. However, the switching characteristics of switch modules in the electric drive system will generate high-voltage transient pulses and harmonic interference, which pose a threat to the electromagnetic compatibility of the power cabin. This paper proposes a system-level conducted EMI prediction method for the EMC problem generated by high-power electric drive systems. Firstly, the models of high-voltage battery pack, inverter, and motor are independently constructed; Then, based on the multi-conductor transmission line method, each model is cascaded through transmission lines that characterize the parasitic effects of the system, and thus forming a distributed system-level conducted EMI prediction model; In addition, the simulation results of the model were compared and verified with the experimental results, verifying that the constructed model achieved simulation accuracy lower than 8 dB in the frequency range of 10 KHz~100 MHz, which can provide effective support for the forward design of system electromagnetic compatibility.

articleTitle: Investigation on Correlation of Shielding Effectiveness of Enclosures with Aperture Between Reverberation Chamber and OATS Method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: At first, the present research status of reverberation chamber in the world was introduced. Then the advantage of the reverberation chamber and traditional EMC testing place were analyzed. Finally, plane waves superposition simulation is used to obtain the shielding effectiveness of a rectangular enclosure with an aperture in the reverberation chamber (RC). By using the statistical definition of SE, the feature of shielding effectiveness in RC were analyzed and discussed, which is good matching to the simulated feature in open area test site (OATS).

articleTitle: An Inductive Wireless Power Transmission System Based on Capacitive Feedback Fractional-order High-frequency Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: This paper proposes an series-series-type (SS-type) inductive wireless power transfer system based on a fractional-order high-frequency oscillator configured with capacitive feedback LC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">β</sup>C. Although the inductor in the frequency-selective network of a fractional-order oscillator can be used directly as a transmitting coil for energy transfer, such systems usually produce low output power. Therefore, this study adds a push-pull power amplifier circuit after the fractional-order capacitive feedback oscillator to enhance the transmission power. In addition, an SS-type compensation network is used to improve transmission efficiency. Compared with wireless power transmission systems that utilize integer-order capacitive feedback high-frequency oscillators, systems designed based on fractional-order high-frequency oscillators have higher transmission power and frequency tunability.

articleTitle: Modeling of EMI Current in Clamping Wires of Medium-Voltage H-Bridge Submodule
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The medium-voltage cascade H-bridge system relies on the H-bridge submodule as its core component. To ensure the insulation performance of the medium voltage H-bridge module, the water-cooled board and chassis will be connected to a potential point in the submodule by clamping wires. However, the use of high-power insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) in the submodule can cause high-frequency currents on the clamping wires due to high-speed potential changes, which may cause electromagnetic interference (EMI) to the drive and controls circuits in submodule. To address this, an EMI model of H-bridge submodule is built to analyze EMI current in clamping wires for different clamping methods. The proposed EMI model is verified by measurement of a H-bridge submodule. Based on the EMI model and measurement results, the design principle of clamping wires in medium-voltage H-bridge submodule is provided to reduce the EMI current in clamping wires.

articleTitle: Research on S-parameter test method for high and low voltage coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: According to the CISPR 25:2016 and GB/T 18655-2018 standard requirements, there are two test methods for new energy vehicle electronic products in the high and low voltage coupling attenuation test, respectively, signal source injection method and direct measurement of S-parameter method. This paper mainly focuses on the network analyzer measurement of S-parameter method for in-depth study, comparing the three different test methods and test arrangements, using the biaxial motor loading stand for verification, for the automobile manufacturers and parts supplier testing to provide EMC rectification verification reference case study, which is of great practical significance.

articleTitle: Measurement and analysis of battery alternating-current impedance by vector network analyzer
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In the life cycle of the battery, its alternating-current (AC) impedance will change with the change of the internal parameters of the battery. Therefore, the AC impedance characteristics of the battery can be used to evaluate the internal state and parameter changes of the battery, thus realizing the detection and analysis of the battery performance. In this paper, different AC impedance testing methods of vector network analyzer are analyzed, and the AC impedance testing scheme of vector network analyzer battery is designed according to the sample characteristics, and then the AC impedance amplitude, phase, real part and imaginary part of batteries with different capacities and voltages are tested and analyzed according to the scheme. In addition, this paper summarizes the shortcomings and improvements of this test, and looks forward to the related work that can be carried out in the future.

articleTitle: Design Method of Magnetic Coupling Mechanism for UAV Wireless Charging System with High Efficiency and Anti-offset Ability
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The wireless charging system for Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) needs to have high power density and efficiency, as well as high anti offset ability, which poses a very high challenge to the design of magnetic coupling mechanisms. This paper focuses on a type of UAV wireless charging system using S-S compensation structure and planar spiral coil. A design method based on the calculation formula of coupling coil performance parameters is proposed, and combined with Ansys Maxwell analysis and optimization of the magnetic shielding structure of the magnetic coupling mechanism. The peak efficiency of the designed magnetic coupling mechanism in a 1kW wireless charging system can reach 94.1%, and the efficiency can reach 91.9% under a lateral displacement of 5cm.

articleTitle: Study on Measurement of Scattering Parameters of Non-Coaxial Interface Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: With the rapid advancements in communication technology, there has been an increasing emphasis on addressing EMC (Electromagnetic Compatibility) issues. When designing EMC at the PCB (Printed Circuit Board) level, having knowledge of the S-parameters (Scattering parameters) of non-coaxial interface devices is essential, which presents a significant challenge for accurate S-parameter measurements. To address this challenge, a T-shaped microstrip line is employed as the DUT (Device Under Test), and the full-wave model of the DUT, test fixture, and calibration standards is designed using HFSS (High Frequency Structure Simulator). Impedance discontinuities at the junction of the microstrip line and pad are compensated and optimized through the use of the anti-pad. The TRL (Thru-Reflect-Line) calibration method is employed to calibrate system errors introduced by the test fixture and obtain accurate S-parameters for the DUT. Both simulation and actual measurements demonstrate that this method accurately measures the S-parameters of the DUT within the frequency range of 0.1 GHz to 14 GHz. The method proposed in this paper offers a straightforward and efficient approach to accurately measure the S-parameters of non-coaxial interface devices, thereby facilitating accurate EMC design at the PCB level.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of the Influence of Wiring Structure on Radiation in Electric Drive System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: With the development of new energy vehicles, the power electronic conversion device in the power size and component density are far more than traditional vehicles, compared with the transmission of fuel vehicles, to face more complex electromagnetic compatibility problems. As one of the key systems of new energy vehicles, the electromagnetic compatibility performance of the electric drive system is not only related to its own working reliability, but also affects the safe operation ability and working reliability of the vehicle. The electric drive system is a complex system, and its wiring harness structure is extremely complex, including high-voltage wiring harness and low-voltage wiring harness. The structure of the wiring harness will affect the performance of the vehicle. Therefore, the study of the influence of the wiring harness structure of the electric drive system on radiation, from the change of the length of the high and low voltage wiring harness and the shielding, the radiation interference of the electric drive system with different wiring harness length and shielding performance is tested and data analysis. The test results show that the length of the wiring harness and the shielding have a greater impact on the radiation interference of the system.

articleTitle: Research On An Active Stealth Method Based On The Technique Of Multi-Source Pair Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Active cancellation stealth is an important part of radar stealth. The traditional active cancellation technique has only one cancellation source, which has poor robustness. In order to further improve the robustness of the active cancellation system, this paper proposes a multi-source cancellation stealth model, applies the power-inversion criterion to calculate the emission waveform of each cancellation source, and solves the problem of energy distribution among multiple cancellation sources. Combined with the null broadening technique, the zero trapping depth in the frequency band is broadened to improve the robustness of the multi-source cancellation system. The simulation results show that the multi-pair cancellation source system has stronger robustness and can better cope with various complex environments compared with the single-pair fading source system.

articleTitle: Design of Active EMI Filter Combining Feedforward and Feedback Control
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Active Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) filter is a commonly used method to solve EMI problem. Firstly, a feedforward voltage compensated active EMI filter based on partial voltage sampling is studied. The parameter design method of filter components is discussed. Then, in order to improve the compensation of feedforward filter, an active EMI filter structure combining feedback is presented. The design method of feedback circuit parameters is analyzed and the stability of the system is discussed. The component parameters are figured out by genetic algorithm. Compared with feedforward filter, the improved topology increases the suppression of common-mode (CM) voltage by adding voltage feedback link, which helps to improve the utilization rate of the CM interference compensation transformer. The effectiveness of the active EMI filter is verified through experiment measurements.

articleTitle: Research on Interference Cancellation Algorithm Based on Multipath Channel Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In order toanalyze theimpact ofmultipath effect on radar interference cancellation performance generated by electromagnetic signals in the process of propagation, the interference cancellation model based on multipath channel is proposed. To describe the signal characteristics in the complex electromagnetic environment more accurately and effectively, a multi-channel model based on ray theory is established. On this basis, the interference cancellation algorithms for multipath channel and Rice channel based on ray theory are derived. Simulation experiments show that this proposed multichannel model based on ray theory accurately simulates the signal propagation path. Futhermore, the multipath signal can improve the zero-trapping of interference cancellation, but it will cause the zero-trapping angle to be shifted, and also cause the algorithm convergence to be degraded.

articleTitle: Distributed modeling of power inductors and analysis of winding method on EMI based on Vienna PFCs
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: With the development of electronic and electrical integration and micro-elementization, the frequency of the working environment of the components is also getting higher and higher, and the challenge of EMI is also greater. For inductors often used in various transformers, switching power supplies, in the high-frequency environment should not only pay attention to its own inductance performance, but also must pay attention to the impact of distributed capacitance on EMI. In this paper, based on the power inductor of the Vienna PFC circuit, the basic inter-turn capacitance microelement composition is first analyzed, and then the capacitance matrix is established for different single-layer coils to build a solution model. Then the interlayer capacitance is modeled and solved for the multilayer model, and finally the inductance distribution model and the simplified lumped model under different winding methods are given. The impedance characteristics of the simplified model are simulated and analyzed by using the simulation software, and the simulation results are compared with the results of the test with an impedance analyzer to verify the feasibility and accuracy of the model from the other side. Finally, the effect of high frequency characteristics of power inductors on EMI noise is analyzed by MATLAB/Simulink simulation and verified by experiment.

articleTitle: A Dead Time Compensation Method of Constant Common Mode Voltage CPS SPWM for MMC
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The modular multi-level converter (MMC) has demonstrated significant potential in high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission and high voltage motor drive applications. Constant common mode voltage (CMV) modulations for MMC can effectively reduce the common mode (CM) electromagnetic interference (EMI) in MMC by minimizing CMV fluctuations to zero under ideal condition. However, the dead time required to protect power semiconductor devices in MMC seriously weakens the suppression effect of constant CMV modulations on CM EMI. This paper presents a method of dead time compensation with carrier phase compensation for MMC using constant CMV carrier phase shifted (CPS) sinusoidal pulse width modulation (SPWM). Phase compensation (PC) CPS SPWM is one of the constant CMV modulations for MMC. The operation principle of PC-CPS SPWM is introduced, and the mechanism of CMV fluctuations caused by dead time is analyzed. Compensation strategies for carrier phase positions and modulation signals in dead time compensation of PC-CPS SPWM are presented as DPC-CPS SPWM. The simulation results validate the proposed method, providing guidance for modulation design in MMC with low EMI requirements.

articleTitle: Passive Shielding Method for Leakage Magnetic Field in WPT System for Electric Vehicle Based on Induction Multi-frequency Resonance
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The wireless power transmission (WPT) system of electric vehicles generates leakage magnetic field at operating frequencies and harmonic frequencies. However, The transmission performance including the constant voltage/constant current output performance, output power, and transmission efficiency of the WPT system are affected by existing passive multi-frequency resonance shielding methods. To cope with it, a passive induction multi-frequency resonant shielding coil design method which minimizes the effect on the transmission performance of WPT systems is proposed in this paper. Based on the proposed method, the shielding effectiveness of the shielding coil is considered. Finally, simulation results show that the leakage magnetic field at two frequencies of WPT system are significantly reduced using the proposed shielding coil.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition Method of Radar Pulse Signal Based on Deep SVDD
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of feature extraction difficulty and low recognition rate caused by the sparsity of radar pulse signal, this paper proposes an intelligent recognition method of radar pulse signal based on deep support vector data description (Deep SVDD). Firstly, the in-phase/quadrature sampling data are preprocessed, and the input real matrix containing both time and frequency domain information is obtained through discrete Fourier transform (DFT) and energy normalization, which significantly simplifies the process of extracting signal features. Then, a deep learning network architecture for radar pulse signal is designed, which includes the residual network, the self-encoder pre-training model and the Deep SVDD network model. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of planar matrix integrated magnetic components
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The customized design of planar magnetic cores and PCB windings, along with repeatable manufacturing, enables the enhancement of efficiency and power density in LLC converters operating at low voltage and high current conditions. This paper comprehensively investigates the stacking method of primary-secondary windings in matrix-integrated transformers as frequency varies. A comparison is made between cylindrical and rectangular cores regarding their magnetic core losses. Utilizing gallium nitride devices, a 1MHz 380V/12V 600W experimental prototype is constructed and tested. The results demonstrate a peak efficiency of 95.6% for the prototype, validating the exceptional performance of planar matrix-integrated magnetic components with an overall power density reaching 461W/in3

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Winding Loss Modeling of Planar Inductors Considering the Effect of Air-Gap Diffusion Flux
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: The winding loss of planar inductors is an important part of magnetic element design, optimization and efficiency of power converter, but an effective evaluation method is still lacking. The traditional calculation of high frequency winding loss of planar inductors often makes some reasonable assumptions about magnetic components, but it fails to properly deal with the influence of edge effect and gap diffusion magnetic field, which makes the calculation accuracy of winding loss low. In this paper, the equivalent surface current of the air gap is used to replace the magnetic voltage drop, the core boundary is removed by the image method, and the planar PCB winding is miniaturized by referring to the idea of solving the interlayer circulation of the parallel winding of the planar transformer. A two-dimensional winding loss model of the planar inductor is established which can accurately evaluate the effect of the air gap diffusion magnetic field. Finally, the correctness and feasibility of the two-dimensional loss model of planar inductors are verified by 2D finite element simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: The influence of edge effects on the evaluation and optimization of planar transformer winding loss
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In order to meet people's pursuit of higher efficiency of power electronic equipment, reducing the winding loss of planar transformer is an important part. Due to the simplicity of the calculation method, the current method used to evaluate the winding loss in the industry mainly is the one-dimensional Dowell model, but with the increase of the operating frequency, the influence of the edge effect caused by the gap between the winding and the core becomes non-negligible, which will affect the calculation accuracy of the Dowell model and lead to the increase of the winding loss. Therefore, the influence of edge effects should be paid attention to when evaluating winding losses, and edge effects should be considered when designing windings to reduce winding losses. In addition, when the air gap avoidance is used to reduce the winding loss in the planar flyback transformer, the winding loss may increase instead of decreasing, and the reasons for this phenomenon are analyzed and an improvement method is proposed, and finally the correctness is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Parasitic Capacitances on Common-Mode EMI in Double Sided Cooling Power Modules
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: This paper investigates the power module design for better common-mode (CM) EMI performance in a double sided cooling power module. The effect of parasitic capacitance on CM EMI is analyzed by using the CM equivalent model. To verify the analysis, a comparative study is conducted between a popular double sided cooling power module and a commercial wire bonded power module. The parasitic extraction results of ANSYS Q3D show that the double sided cooling power module faces more serve CM EMI issues due to the larger output-side capacitance. Simulation results also show that reasonable parasitic values and parameter symmetry can improve CM EMI performance. Based on the above studies, a design guidance of the double sided cooling power module are given for better CM EMI.

articleTitle: PT-Symmetric Wireless Power Transfer System Based on Triple Transmitting Coils
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Wireless power transfer (WPT) systems based on the principle of parity-time (PT) symmetry offer significant benefits such as robust output power and high efficiency. It is also known that an increased number of transmitting coils can achieve a more homogeneous distribution of magnetic field and improve the system’s tolerance to coil offset. In this paper, the principle of PT symmetry is applied to a WPT system with triple-transmitting coil structure to obtain constant power and constant transmission efficiency over an extended range. The experimental results proved that when the coupling coefficient between each transmitting coil is 0.579, the system’s critical coupling coefficient is decreased by 15.8% compared to a PT-WPT system with single-transmitting coil structure, and the transmission efficiency is maintained above 94%. In addition, by adjusting the magnitude of the coupling coefficient between each transmitting coil, the PT-symmetric region of the proposed system could be enlarged and the output power could be increased.

articleTitle: Research on electromagnetic compatibility test of bearing voltage in high voltage system
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the mechanism of bearing voltage generation in new energy vehicles, starting from the key factors of radiation emission caused by bearing voltage in the electromagnetic compatibility test process of high voltage drive system, this paper puts forward a variety of suppression schemes of radiation emission caused by shaft electricity, and makes comparative analysis from the dimensions of feasibility, effectiveness, reliability, etc., and puts forward a more reasonable engineering suppression scheme. With the actual test, the bearing voltage control index is quantified to ensure that the test and quantification of bearing voltage can be based on in the development process of high voltage electric drive system engineering.

articleTitle: Multi-load WPT System for Battery Charging with Overshoot Suppression During Constant-voltage and Constant-current Modes Switching
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: In the process of battery charging, the equivalent resistance may change from several ohm to several hundred ohms, so the charging mode of constant current first and then constant voltage is generally adopted. Taking the battery of electric bicycle as an example, there are many kinds of voltage and capacity specifications on the market. Under the current mode of shared charging pile or shared charging station, it is necessary to design a wireless power transmission system (WPT) that can charge multiple batteries with a single inverter and flexibly provide a variety of charging voltage and current on the same platform with load independent characteristics. This paper mainly proposes a constant voltage and constant current wireless power transmission system with multi load and multi gear based on reconfigurable intermediate coil. By changing the switch state combination of the intermediate coil, three working modes of constant current fast charging, constant current slow charging and constant voltage charging are realized. In the constant-current (CC) mode and constant-voltage (CV) mode, the system achieves zero phase angle (ZPA), zero voltage switching of inverter switch tube, and the working frequency of the system is consistent before and after switching between different modes, so as to effectively suppress the overshoot current or voltage during modes switching, and improve the working efficiency of the system. The feasibility of the designed system is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Compatibility Analysis and Optimization of a Resolver for Measuring the Angular Displacement in High-Power Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: As a high-precision measurement device of angular displacement and angular velocity, the stability and robustness to harsh environments make resolver the first choice for many rotating equipment monitoring systems, which plays a vital role in a variety of industrial applications. However, in fact that the resolver is essentially a sensor in compliance with the principle of electromagnetic induction, which means that its performance is affected by the complex electromagnetic environment in the presence of multiple potential sources of interference. In this paper, a sine-cosine resolver of Model SG110-XXV1 is applied to a high-power synchronous motor, and induced voltage of the resolver appears to be distorted during the experimental process, which affects the measurement accuracy of angular displacement and the control operation of motor. In order to accurately determine the source of interference and find an effective solution, this paper establishes a complete set of Electromagnetic compatibility (EMC)analysis process and test system. After the spectrum analysis of distorted waveforms, the results show that excessive armature magnetic field and excitation magnetic field of motor will have an impact on the resolver, the baseband frequency related to rotational speed is out of range, which should take certain solutions such as designing a corresponding filter to eliminate interference. After the implementation of the proposed solution, the completeness of the analysis process and the effectiveness of the solution are confirmed through experimental verification, which not only restores the normal output signal of resolver, but also forms a complete closed-loop control system between the high-power synchronous motor and the resolver, which ensures the stable operation and great dynamic performance of the system.

articleTitle: Design and realization of three-phase EMI noise separator
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd China Power Supply Society Electromagnetic Compatibility Conference (CPEMC)
abstract: With the increase of switching frequency and power density of switching converters, the influence of conducted electromagnetic interference (EMI) gradually increases, and the design requirements of EMI filters are also gradually improved, in order to improve the design efficiency of EMI filters, this paper designs a three-phase EMI noise separator. This paper first analyzes the measurement method of three-phase noise and gives the decoupling method of differential mode (DM) noise and common mode (CM) noise, and then designs a three-phase noise separator based on it, and also theoretically analyzes its operation principle and input impedance, and finally designs relevant experiments to verify the feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Modeling Method Of Conducted EMI In DC/DC Switching Power Supply Module
